# Replications 1 to 3 on CorrNet + Phoenix-T using the checkpoints generated by the initial Randomly Sampled labeled pool

for i in {1..3}; do python3 activelearning.py -d dataset/phoenix2014-T/ -f 10342 10342 10342 10342 20684 20684 20684 41367 41367 -w /workdir/work_dir/CorrNet/Phoenix2014-T/RaidalR0/Rep${i} -n RaidalR0Rep${i} -s raidal-R0 --device 0 -b 0 --config configs/baseline-replication${i}-T.yaml --checkpoint /workdir/work_dir/CorrNet/Phoenix2014-T/Random/Rep${i}/phoenix2014-T-RandomRep${i}-labeled-iteration1 --use-features /workdir/work_dir/CorrNet/Phoenix2014-T/Random/Rep${i}/phoenix2014-T-RandomRep${i}-labeled-iteration1-features/ /workdir/work_dir/CorrNet/Phoenix2014-T/Random/Rep${i}/phoenix2014-T-RandomRep${i}-unlabeled-iteration1-features/; done

# Replications 1 to 3 on CorrNet + Phoenix2014 using the checkpoints generated by the initial Randomly Sampled labeled pool

for i in {1..3}; do python3 activelearning.py -d dataset/phoenix2014 -f 10000 10000 10000 10000 20000 20000 20000 40000 40000 -w /workdir/work_dir/CorrNet/Phoenix2014/Raidal/Rep${i} -n RaidalRep${i} -s raidal --device 0 -b 0 --config configs/baseline-replication${i}.yaml --checkpoint /workdir/work_dir/CorrNet/Phoenix2014/Random/Rep${i}/phoenix2014-RandomRep${i}-labeled-iteration1 --use-features /workdir/work_dir/CorrNet/Phoenix2014/Random/Rep${i}/phoenix2014-RandomRep${i}-labeled-iteration1-features/ /workdir/work_dir/CorrNet/Phoenix2014/Random/Rep${i}/phoenix2014-RandomRep${i}-unlabeled-iteration1-features/; done
